title: Stocks Fall as Oil Jump Keeps Bond Yields Elevated: Markets Wrap
summary: A fresh bout of bond volatility left traders unwilling to make riskier bets, with stocks falling on worries that an oil rally will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.

title: US 30-Year Bond Enters September on Worst Stretch Since 2006

title: Peru Inflation Just Tops Estimate to Hit Fastest Since 2023

title: Jain's Fund to Manage Money Just for Millennium
